SKILLS
SITARAM KESHARI MAHAPATRAAssociate
Software Developer
+917008688366Bengaluru
, Karnataka, India
MESoftware
Developer with 3+ years of experience in Angular (v10+), ReactJS, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, Java andRESTful
APIs, specializing in building scalable and high-performance web applications. Skilled in FullStack development,
performance optimization, and Agile collaboration, with proven client-facing experience. Worked closely with testers,
UI/UX designers, and product managers to deliver responsive, scalable, and user-friendly applications.
WORK EXPERIENCERumango
(Aug) - 2024(Sept)
Developed and maintained scalable and responsive web applications using Angular and React.
Applied Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts and design patterns to write clean, structured, and reusablecode
Ensured all applications followed modular architecture for easy maintenance and future scalability.
Collaborated with backend teams to align front-end design with APIs and server-side logic.
UI/UX Optimization
Improved application performance, speed, and usability by optimizing code and reusing components.
Worked closely with UI/UX designers to ensure consistent branding and a user-friendly interface.
Fixed cross-browser issues and implemented responsive layouts for mobile, tablet, and desktop devices.
Participated in regular code reviews to maintain quality and consistency across the project.
API Integration & Security
Integrated REST APIs and microservices into Angular and React applications to enable smooth data flow betweenfrontend
Implemented secure authentication and authorization using JWT, OAuth2, and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).
Followed best security practices to protect sensitive user and client data during API communication.
Ensured all integrations were thoroughly tested and well-documented for easy maintenance.
Agile Collaboration
Actively contributed to Agile and Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives.
Maintained open communication with stakeholders for smooth delivery and transparency.
Testing & Tooling
Followed Test-Driven Development (TDD) and Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) practices for reliable code quality.
Created unit and integration tests using Jasmine, Karma, and React Testing Library.
Used tools like Angular CLI, NPM, Chrome DevTools, and Postman for efficient debugging and testing.
Ensured new features passed quality checks before deployment to production.
Cloud, Deployment & Documentation
Supported CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and GitHub Actions to automate build and deployment processes.
Deployed web applications on Oracle WebLogic Server ensuring stable and secure releases.
Created technical documentation, user guides, and process notes for smooth handover and knowledge transfer.
Collaborated with DevOps teams to monitor deployments and resolve production issues efficiently.
Rumango Software and Consulting Services Pvt Ltd.
